definition: Nathalie Japkowicz is a Canadian computer scientist specializing in machine learning.
details: She is a professor and department chair of computer science at the American University College of Arts and Sciences.

explainer.lead: Nathalie Japkowicz is a Canadian computer scientist. Her work spans computer science, artificial intelligence, machine learning and big data.

contributions.name: Japkowicz has contributed work on mitigating class imbalance issues in machine learning.

timeline.what: Japkowicz completed a B.Sc. at McGill University in 1988.
She earned an M.Sc. from the University of Toronto in 1990.
She completed a Ph.D. at Rutgers University in 1999.
Receives the Lifetime Achievement Award of the Canadian Artificial Intelligence Association

affiliations: American University College of Arts and Sciences
